evidence.quote: as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus,

The safety and effectiveness of VICTOZA as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in type 2 diabetes mellitus have been established in pediatric patients 10 years of age and older.

response.reasoning: The claim states that VICTOZA improves blood sugar control in adults and children 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes. The label excerpts support this claim for adults, as stated in the Indications and Usage section (excerpt id: victoza:v31:1:0). For children 10 years and older, the excerpts state that the safety and effectiveness of VICTOZA have been established in pediatric patients 10 years of age and older (excerpt id: victoza:v31:23:0).
